scope: Authorized staged expansion of guided P5. Calibration acquisition first, then held-out evaluation only after adequate independent verified calibration and technical integrity. All assigned outcomes retained. No verifier feedback during generation. Identical random-chain graph family; not new mathematical task families.
stop_rule: Fixed counts; no additional sampling based on evaluation outcomes. Insufficient calibration withholds evaluation and is reported.
calibration_fold: SHA256(problem_id) parity assignment independent of responses; threshold and transform tasks disjoint.
